(AP Photo/Alessandra Tarantino, File) The 2027 edition of the FIFA Women’s World Cup will be played across eight cities in Brazil, with each city staging at least seven matches at the tournament. Chennai The iconic Maracanã Stadium in Rio De Janeiro will host the final of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, the International Football Association (FIFA) announced on Thursday. The announcement was made when the governing body released the World Cup schedule using placeholders, confirming when and where all 64 fixtures will be played across eight cities in Brazil.

news.title: Resign Gianni Infantino: Football fans launch petition for sacking of FIFA President
news.lede: Football supporters' organisations from several parts of the world have joined forces to demand the resignation of FIFA president Gianni Infantino, following controversy over his reported attempt to offer future World Cup revenues to private investors. The campaign, launched on Thursday under the hashtag #InfantinoOut, also urges a major overhaul of FIFA's governance, arguing that the organisation needs to be restructured to prevent similar controversies from occurring again. "The shameful attempt by one individual - the FIFA President himself - to sell off the World Cup to private investors exposed a betrayal football will never forget," the petition said about Infantino's plan for a commercial spinoff. Among the groups backing the petition are Football Supporters Europe, Football Supporters Africa and the Independent Supporters Council in North America.

news.title: One year to go: Qatar counts down to 2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup
news.lede: Qatar is one year away from the FIBA Basketball World Cup, when 32 national teams and some of the sport’s biggest stars will compete in Doha. The tournament, running from 27 August to 12 September 2027, will be the first edition hosted in the Middle East, with 92 games played across four arenas. One of the most visible changes is taking place at a familiar venue from the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Al Janoub Stadium has been transformed into Al Janoub Arena, an 8,200-seat basketball venue that will host its first game next week.

news.title: Soccer fans launch global petition urging FIFA boss Infantino to resign over World Cup 'betrayal'
news.lede: GENEVA — A collection of soccer fan groups from around the world launched a petition Thursday calling for Gianni Infantino to resign as FIFA president after he tried to sell future World Cup profits to private investors. The petition with the hashtag InfantinOut also calls for "FIFA to be rebuilt so that the current debacle can never happen again." "The shameful attempt by one individual — the FIFA President himself — to sell off the World Cup to private investors exposed a betrayal football will never forget," the petition said about Infantino's plan for a commercial spinoff, which he dropped amid a furious backlash. The fan groups include Football Supporters Europe, Football Supporters Africa and, in North America, the Independent Supporters Council, plus about 40 national fan groups worldwide.
